repairs.quote: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after 4 seconds, or when this ability is Recast. It deals (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage to enemies and Knocks them Back. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Satchel Charge will automatically destroy towers below 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% of their Health.
